Callout.Name: Theft from an Orchard
Callout.Message: Fruit taken from an orchard overnight.
Callout.Advisory: Trailer tracks at the gate, nobody present.

Script.Line: The gate was open when I drove past at six.
That is a two hour job and a trailer, and nobody saw a thing.
I have not had anything off that orchard in twenty years.

Lines.Approach: They have taken a trailer load in the night and the gate was open for them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
